afrixnli.title: AfriXNLI (Masakhane mirror)
afrixnli.description: XNLI dev/test subset translated into 16 African languages; 1,050 premise-hypothesis pairs per language (450 dev + 600 test), 3-way NLI labels. Role in project: cross-language evaluation harness (entailment->1, contradiction->0, neutral excluded - proxy labels, bias documented in feasibility report section 5.3).
afrixnli.citation: Adelani, D. I. et al. AfriXNLI (Masakhane), IrokoBench family. https://huggingface.co/datasets/masakhane/afrixnli (Apache-2.0); CC-BY-4.0 mirror: https://huggingface.co/datasets/mteb/AfriXNLI

igbonlp_benchmark.title: IGBONLP Igbo-English MT benchmark subset
igbonlp_benchmark.description: Human-translated Igbo-English parallel benchmark (~10,752 pairs: 10,000 train / 200 val / 552 test). Role: Igbo raw material for constructed pairs. JW300-derived folders of the same repository are EXCLUDED (withdrawn corpus; licence red flag).
igbonlp_benchmark.license_note: No LICENSE file on the GitHub repository or HF mirror. Research use only; no redistribution of data or derivatives without author permission (not requested, per researcher decision).
igbonlp_benchmark.citation: Ezeani, I., et al. (2020). Igbo-English Machine Translation: An Evaluation Benchmark. LREC 2020. arXiv:2004.00648. Data: github.com/IgnatiusEzeani/IGBONLP ig_en_mt/benchmark_dataset/

menyo20k_mt.title: Menyo-20k (Yoruba-English parallel corpus)
menyo20k_mt.description: 20,100 en-y0 parallel pairs (news + broadcast + web text; human translations). Role: Yoruba raw material for constructed paraphrase pairs and register analysis.
menyo20k_mt.license_note: Non-commercial; derivatives restricted to research use.
menyo20k_mt.citation: Alabi et al. Menyo-20k Multilingual Yoruba-English corpus. DOI 10.5281/zenodo.4297448; github.com/uds-lsv/menyo-20k_MT (CC-BY-NC-4.0). Author list to be confirmed against the README during the audit step.

ntrex_african.title: NTREX-african (Masakhane; NTREX-128 news subset)
ntrex_african.description: ~2,000 professionally written news sentences per language, parallel across languages. Role: additional sentence pool for constructed pairs (CC-BY-SA share-alike applies to any redistributed text).
ntrex_african.license_note: Share-alike: derivatives containing this text must be CC-BY-SA.
ntrex_african.citation: Masakhane, NTREX-african (NTREX-128 news test set subset). https://huggingface.co/datasets/masakhane/ntrex_african (CC-BY-SA-4.0); original: Federmann, Kuzman et al., NTREX-128.

semrel2024_hau.title: SemRel2024 Hausa (SemEval-2024 Task 1, Track A)
semrel2024_hau.description: Human-annotated semantic textual relatedness pairs for Hausa: 3,473 train / 425 dev / 1,207 test with continuous 0-1 scores (Best-Worst Scaling). Role: Hausa supervised training + similarity evaluation; binary label via validation-tuned threshold.
semrel2024_hau.license_note: No LICENSE file in the source repository. Per researcher decision (2026-11-19): use as published research data WITHOUT contacting authors; no redistribution of this data or derivatives in any release. Cite the SemEval-2024 Task 1 paper.
semrel2024_hau.citation: Ousidhoum, N., Muhammad, S. H., et al. (2024). SemRel2024: A Collection of Semantic Textual Relatedness Datasets for 13 Languages (Findings of ACL 2024, arXiv:2402.08638); SemEval-2024 Task 1 (arXiv:2403.18933). Data: github.com/semantic-textual-relatedness/Semantic_Relatedness_SemEval2024

paws_wiki_en.title: PAWS-Wiki Labeled Final (English)
paws_wiki_en.description: Human-written paraphrase/non-paraphrase pairs from Wikipedia with strong lexical-overlap control (49,401 train / ~2k dev / ~2k test, binary labels). Role in project: SOURCE for constructed target-language pairs via machine translation of BOTH pair members (translate-train; PAWS-style overlap control is inherited by the translated pairs). English pairs are also the training source for the E5 zero-shot transfer experiment.
paws_wiki_en.license: Freely usable for any purpose (Google LLC dataset notice)
paws_wiki_en.license_note: May be freely used for any purpose; acknowledgement of Google LLC appreciated; provided AS IS. Redistributing DERIVATIVES built from it is permitted by this notice.
paws_wiki_en.citation: Zhang, Y., Baldridge, J., & He, L. (2019). PAWS: Paraphrase Adversaries from Word Scrambling. NAACL 2019; Yang, Y., Zhang, Y., Tar, C., & Baldridge, D. (2019). PAWS-X. EMNLP 2019. github.com/google-research-datasets/paws
